name: Block-based intra-band prediction
definition: A prediction scheme applied before EBCOT encoding to exploit anatomical symmetry correlations in wavelet coefficients by predicting blocks from previously encoded blocks using geometric transformations.
summary: Block-based intra-band prediction is a lossless compression technique for wavelet coefficients that exploits anatomical symmetries in CT scans using geometric transformations, unlike generic methods ineffective on non-symmetrical data.
